description: This Java class, EntityTagBuilder, is responsible for generating EntityTag instances based on given entities or objects. It provides methods to build entity tags for top-level entities (with revision info) and sub-entities (using hash codes).

classes.name: EntityTagBuilder
classes.description: A utility class for building EntityTag objects from entities or objects.

methods.name: buildFromEntity
methods.description: Generates an EntityTag for the given entity object, handling nulls and differentiating between Entity instances and other objects.

methods.name: buildForTopLevelEntity
methods.description: Creates an EntityTag for an Entity that extends Revision if it is not deleted.

methods.name: buildForSubEntity
methods.description: Creates an EntityTag based on the hash code of a generic object, suitable for sub-entities.

methods.name: enquote
methods.description: Utility method to enclose a string in double quotes.
